Subject: Trial expired — request for short extension to finish POC

Thanks again for the time last week. We're pretty far along with the integration work, but our evaluation ran into a hard stop when the sandbox credits exhausted on Nov 20. A couple of engineers are still validating throughput and hallucination thresholds tied to our data pipeline — if we can't finish those tests we won't be able to make the business case internally.

Would Redwood consider a short extension (2 weeks) or a temporary sandbox top-up so we can complete the POC? I can share a light usage report and the exact tests we'll run. We expect to make a go/no-go decision by mid-December.

Appreciate any help — Oliver

Risk notes: public endpoint access only, no data residency exceptions requested. We should require an updated terms redline if they accept an extension with additional usage. If approved, I'll send a concise confirmation to Oliver with the extension window and the Drive link to the usage policy.
